reviews.title: Buyer beware, may not work for you.
reviews.comment: I bought this item to replace the original main power cable to motherboard because it was way too short. This cable is missing pins within the plugs and would not allow the computer to start up, the fans would slightly turn and flash... then nothing. I singled it out to this cord being the problem by process of elimination which required me to almost completely tear apart my entire build trying to figure out the problem. I have an EVGA Supernova 850 GM and an ASUS B550m-A Wifi motherboard. This cord may be useful for something, but not THIS build. Completely useless to me.
reviews.author: Duke of earl

reviews.title: Scam product: Do NOT Buy
reviews.comment: If you’re like me and need a cable to connect your power supply to your motherboard, do NOT buy this. It is a scam product and does not work. It has missing pins and simply doesn’t work. It’s likely some sweatshop product from the misfit assembly line and they’re just trying to cheat their way to money.
